the_instrument_defect.observation: navigate -> drag-sort-numbers; location 0.5s later = drag-sort-numbers; 1.0s = search-engine; 1.5s = sign-agreement; 2.0s = simon-says
the_instrument_defect.cause: A full-corpus run and an isolated probe were alive simultaneously and both drove the same CDP browser on 127.0.0.1:9222. Each navigated the other's page away mid-episode.
the_instrument_defect.consequence: start() polls the goal for up to 3.6 s. A probe for drag-sort-numbers read 'Enter the username "kasie" and the password...' and was scored on it. Per-task numbers taken while another run was alive were mixtures of one task's goal and another task's reward.
the_instrument_defect.fix: run_episode raises PAGE_IS_NOT_THE_TASK when location.pathname is not the task the harness asked for; the trial is discarded and reported, never scored.

the_arithmetic_that_settles_it: click-dialog 0/3 -> 3/3 is +3 trials. On a 270-trial held-out set that is +1.1 pp. The other held-out tasks moved -1.9 pp net. At 3 reps per task a single-task fix is smaller than the per-task noise the session measured directly (click-color, unchanged code, three runs: 10/12, 7/12, 6/12). No 130x3 total can arbitrate a per-task change.
what_is_defensible: click-dialog 12/12 with page identity verified every rep (was 0 in every prior run)
the harness can no longer score a page it did not navigate to
what_is_not_defensible: that the held-out rate improved this round -- it did not, it moved -0.74 pp
any per-task +/- within a 130x3 run, including the ones that look good
law_added: A single CDP browser is a shared resource. Any episode whose location is not the task asked for must be discarded, and a per-task claim needs more reps than the total has room for.
